    <GBSeq_comment>Original source text: Human fetal liver DNA, clone pA4.; Draft entry and sequence in computer readable form for [1] kindly provided by I.Gonzalez, 15-FEB-1986.~Six human 28S D6 regions were examined which yielded three versions of this highly variable region.
